about:
# Lattice: Party & Raid Frames

Party and raid frames for WoW Forever: corner spell indicators, an easy settings window, click-casting, aura and dispel highlights, and profiles.

## Use
- `/lattice` opens the settings. `/lattice unlock` lets you move the frames. `/lattice preview 20` shows fake frames.
- `/lattice status` shows why frames or auras are or aren't showing.
- `/lattice tank <name>`, `/lattice notank <name>`, `/lattice autotank <name>` fix the tank guess for a player; `/lattice tanks` lists who counts as tank.
- `/lattice feedback` (or the Feedback button in the settings) shows a link for reporting bugs and ideas.
- `/lattice ai` (or the AI help button in the settings) shows a description of every setting to paste into an AI chat assistant along with what you want; paste its answer into `/lattice apply`, which shows each change before applying it. Changes made in combat apply when combat ends.
- `/lattice <setting> <value>` changes one setting from chat (`/lattice get` lists them), e.g. `/lattice layouts.raid.width 90`.
- `/lattice show <spell>`, `/lattice hide <spell>`, `/lattice unlist <spell>` edit the aura filters (name or spell ID).
- `/lattice search <words>` opens the settings with the search box filled; `/lattice version`; `/lattice help` (or `?`) lists every command, and a mistyped one suggests the nearest. `/lat` works as well as `/lattice`.
- Ctrl+Alt+Right-click a frame: tank choice for that player and a picker for their auras.

## Features
- Party, raid and large-raid layouts that switch automatically. Pet frames in their own movable block (Layout page).
- Click-casting on frames: mouse buttons 1-5 with Shift, Ctrl and Alt.
- Hover-casting: bind a key to a spell and it casts on whoever the mouse is over, optionally falling back to your friendly target, then to you (friendly spells only; on for new keys, a switch per key, and "New keys cast on me" sets where it starts).
- Your HoTs and buffs, debuffs, boss debuff and big defensives, with optional seconds-left numbers. Spell indicators in the frame corners, plus one-click presets for your class.
- Dispel highlight: a big icon of a debuff you can remove in the middle of the frame, edged in its type's colour, plus an optional coloured border or tint.
- Raid buffs in a row beside each frame, and a mark on players missing your class's buff.
- The 5-second rule: after a mana spell, a thin line over the mana bar drains for 5 seconds, then glows while mana comes back (you and your healers, or anyone you pick). `/lattice 5sr` turns it on or off.
- The 5Sr bar: a thin bar to place anywhere. It counts up for the 5 seconds after you spend mana, then turns bright and shows your mp5 while your mana comes back (in combat, or always if you like). `/lattice 5sr move` to place it, `/lattice 5sr widget off` to turn it off.
- Incoming heals, shields, low health warning, range fade (by your heal's range), role, leader, raid marker, ready check, resurrect and summon icons. Dead players tint red, offline players grey.
- Tank frames with each tank's target, in raids.
- Profiles per spec (on clients with specs), and one string to share your whole setup.
- Works in combat: health, heals, shields, range and auras keep updating during fights.
- Tank guessing when the group has no roles, power bars by power type and role, and aura filters (always show / never show).

## Changes

What's new in each version: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/quikmn/LatticePartyRaidFrames/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install
WowUp: pick **World of Warcraft: Forever**, then Get Addons → Install from URL, and paste `https://github.com/quikmn/LatticePartyRaidFrames`.

By hand: download the latest zip from Releases and unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns`.

releases.notes: - Whichever window you click now comes to the front.

- The 5Sr bar shows "5Sr" once while you move it, not twice.
- Unlock frames: the boxes no longer sit on top of each other. Party and raid frames share a spot, so only the box of the one in use shows (pick a raid size in the preview to move the raid frames). If you never moved them, the party and raid frames now sit a little lower, under the Tanks box.
- Hover-casting: each key shows its spell on one line and who it lands on under it, and long keys wrap, so nothing is cut off.
- Settings search: the sidebar lights the page of the top result while you search.

- New: the 5Sr bar, a thin bar you can place anywhere. After you spend mana it counts up over the 5 seconds; then it turns bright and shows your mp5 while your mana comes back. It shows in combat and fades out after (turn off "Only in combat" to keep it up). Width, height, colours and the mp5 text on the Appearance page. Move it with Unlock frames or `/lattice 5sr move`; `/lattice 5sr widget off` turns it off.

- New: the 5-second rule. After you spend mana, a thin line over your mana bar drains for 5 seconds (no Spirit regen), then glows green while your mana comes back. Shown for you and your group's healers; pick who, colours and a seconds number on the Appearance page, or type `/lattice 5sr`.
- Fix: after the latest WoW Forever client update, your character's settings (profile, click-casting) could be saved under the wrong name. They now stay with your character.

- Names and health text stay readable on top of the big dispel icon (it used to cover them).
- The leader crown sits beside the role icon instead of on top of it.
- "AFK" and the health text no longer print over each other; the health text comes back as soon as the player is back.
- Smoother in big raids: frames refresh once when lots of players join or leave, and use less memory.
- The preview no longer shows auras or a dispel highlight on an offline player.
- Settings search also finds sections: type export, import, preset, indicator, filter, profile or reset position.
- Aura filters: one highlighted button (Always show); Add from text is a plain button. The dispel highlight's "How" is now "Frame color style".
- Fix: if one change waiting for combat to end failed, the changes queued after it were skipped until the next fight.
- An old "Lattice" folder that is turned off at login no longer reacts to game events for the rest of the session.
- Hover-casting: new keys now cast on you when nobody fitting is under the mouse and you have no fitting target (friendly spells only). A new switch on the Hover-casting page, "New keys cast on me when nobody else fits", sets where a new key's "cast on me" starts. If you used Lattice before, it stays off for you, and the keys you already have don't change.
- AI help works now: the AI help button (or `/lattice ai`) gives you a description of every setting to paste into an AI chat assistant; paste its answer into `/lattice apply`, which shows every change before making it. Changes made in combat wait until the fight is over.
- Settings can be changed from chat too: `/lattice layouts.raid.width 90`; `/lattice get` lists them all.
